_comment: Bleakhold: Crucible of Onyxia (map 902) -- a 10-man raid built as one continuous volcanic caldera.
Axes (MapForge, like royale_v1): a feature's [x, y] is world [X, Y]; tiles.x runs along world Y and tiles.y
along world X, so the block is X -533.33..533.33 by Y -1066.67..533.33 and the long axis is Y. The raid runs
north (Y+, the high entrance rim) to south (Y-, Onyxia at the caldera floor), descending the whole way.
The three legs, centred on X = 0:
1. Fire-Cult Chasm  (Y ~ +230): the real Ragefire Chasm WMO (client name LavaDungeon) set in a rock pad.
2. the Molten Basin  (Y ~ -150): the showpiece -- a lava lake (liquid_type 3) with a raised basalt
causeway crossing it, lava flanking both sides. Molten Core has no WMO (it is ADT terrain on its own
map), so its leg is built terrain in MC's register, not its rooms. This is where the 'molten core'
feel is carried by the map itself.
3. Onyxia's Own     (Y ~ -720): the real Onyxia's Lair WMO (KL_OnyxiasLair_B) sunk into the caldera floor.
An enclosing volcanic mountain range (the 'mountains' feature) walls the caldera instead of a plain cliff.
Both WMO paths are confirmed from the live client's archives (list_client_files.py). Still provisional until
a build with --assets reads the real model boxes (wmo_info.py gives them): each WMO's pad height (so players
enter at the model's own floor, floor = pad_z + bbox_min_z) and its facing (so the approach meets the door).
The pad z values below (RFC 16, Onyxia 1) and facings are first guesses to be corrected from wmo_info.py.
pois feed the raid's spawn-anchor SQL (package.py writes it from pois.json), the way bh_royale_poi does for
Royale: 'entrance' the start, 'intro_boss'/'final_boss' the two encounters, 'trash_anchor' the trash packs.
Texture 'color' values are tuned for the preview (which shades by them); the BLP paths are stock Blackrock
Mountain / lava tileset paths and are resolved against the client at build time (terrain/validate.py
--assets), the same as every MapForge spec.

features._: north entrance terrace: the raid spawns on a high shelf, kept inside the mountain foot (Y<383)
ramp down from the terrace to the Fire-Cult Chasm pad
Fire-Cult Chasm pad: flat ground the Ragefire WMO stands on (z adjusts to the model floor)
gentle descent from the chasm shoulder down to the molten basin
the molten basin FLOOR: a broad dry basalt flat at z 3. The lava pools are separate lake shapes cut
keep the central causeway spine a touch higher so the path between the two lava fields reads as a road
the land-bridge shoulder rising from the basin floor toward Onyxia
Onyxia's bowl: the sunken caldera floor her lair sits in (dry, ember-lit; z adjusts to model floor)
the caldera wall: a jagged volcanic range on every edge, ledged faces, a steep foot that seals it

lakes._: WEST lava field: a magma body (liquid_type 3), jagged polygon outline, all X < -46 (dry causeway east)
lakes.name: lava_west

lakes._: EAST lava field: the other field across the causeway, its own jagged outline, all X > 46
lakes.name: lava_east

lakes._: lair moat, WEST half: lava guarding Onyxia's left; the dry land-bridge passes through the X=0 gap
lakes.name: lair_moat_w

lakes._: lair moat, EAST half: the matching crescent on Onyxia's right side of the land-bridge
lakes.name: lair_moat_e

_lake_note: Each lake floods its whole shape (the shape is the lava's extent), so the dry basalt causeway and floor are the ground OUTSIDE these polygons. The two basin fields sit either side of the X=0 causeway spine (z 5); the lair moat is crossed by the land-bridge on the way to Onyxia.

texture_rules._: obsidian-black rock on the high steep ground only (mountain faces); low pool rims stay ember
broken basalt patches over the base ash on the open ground (the dominant floor tone)
a tight glowing-ember rim only at the lava's edge (the lowest ground), nowhere else
cinder grass clinging to the high north terrace (the only ground that is not scorched bare)
the roads (causeway and approaches) paint their basalt here

wmos._comment: Ragefire Chasm (client name: Orgrimmar Lava Dungeon). Path confirmed from the client. Pad z and facing provisional until wmo_info.py gives the real box and door.
wmos.label: RFC_ANCHOR

wmos._comment: Onyxia's Lair main hall (KL_OnyxiasLair_B; the _A entrance stretch can be added once their real offset is read). Pad z and facing provisional until wmo_info.py gives the real box and door.
wmos.label: ONY_ANCHOR

_molten_core_note: There is no Molten Core WMO: the whole client Dungeon\ WMO tree was listed and MC is not in it (the
AZ_Blackrock models are Blackrock Depths and Spire). MC is ADT terrain on its own map, so its leg is the
lava basin and causeway built here, not MC's rooms. Importing MC's real geometry would mean copying its
ADT tiles, which this generator does not do.
